MS-DRG Selection & ICD-10 Coding
We have hired highly certified general surgery coders & billers who are masters in handling emergency room e-codes & MS-DRG/ICD-10 codes. Our team stays updated with 2024 & 2025 CPT code changes, like replacing 49203?49205 with 49186?49190. Our general surgery billing services help you achieve 3x more clean claims in the first submission.

Accurate Use of Modifiers

At E-nnovationrcm, we apply accurate surgical modifiers, such as 58 for staged procedures, 24/25 for E/M visits, 78/79 for post-operative care, and modifier 22 for increased procedural complexity. We also ensure accurate billing across 0/10/90-day global periods, including proper use of modifiers 54 & 55 for split care.

Unbundling & Bundling

Incorrect bundling or unbundling can lead to costly denials and compliance issues. We stay aligned with NCCI edits to ensure that procedures are billed separately only when necessary, to avoid rejections. We also help you navigate BPCI-Advanced bundles to ensure easy reimbursement of your payments and meet the criteria with 100% accuracy.

Error-Free Documentation

From pre-authorizations and eligibility checks to precise procedure documentation, we ensure that everything is accurate for clean and fast claims processing. We use electronic charge capture tools and CPT-based charge sheets to minimize the number of missed charges. By outsourcing surgical RCM to the E-nnovationrcm solution, you can achieve a 15% increase in charge capture accuracy.

Value-Based & Medicaid Bundle Models

When we begin working with your practice, we offer patient-centric services that help increase your retention rate. We offer good-faith estimates (No Surprise Act) to make your bills more accurate and transparent for your patients. We also allow text-to-pay and self-service portals to simplify elective surgery deposits and enhance the patient payment experience.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is included in surgical revenue cycle management services across the United States and Canada?

Surgical revenue cycle management (RCM) encompasses the entire billing process:

?

  • Verifying patient eligibility
  • Obtaining prior authorizations
  • Accurately coding surgical procedures
  • Applying right modifiers
  • Submitting clean claims
  • Managing denials
  • Tracking global periods
  • Following up on outstanding accounts receivable (A/R)
  • Documentation audits
  • Reporting
How to choose an inpatient & outpatient surgery billing solutions company?

Choosing the right inpatient and outpatient surgery billing solutions company means looking beyond basic billing support. You need a team that understands the complexities of surgical billing ? from coding accuracy to payer compliance. Here?s what to look for:

?

Certified Coders: AAPC- or AHIMA-certified coders who specialize in general surgery and understand CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding guidelines for both inpatient and outpatient cases.

?

Experience with Surgical Billing: Look for demonstrated success in billing for procedures like colectomies, laparoscopic cholecystectomies, tumor excisions (CPT 49186?49190), and hernia repairs, across both hospital and ASC settings.

?

Technology-Driven Processes: Choose a company that uses real-time eligibility tools (270/271 checks), payer-specific pre-auth workflows, and automated claims scrubbing to speed up your revenue cycle.


Compliance & Reporting: They should follow CMS and NCCI guidelines and provide regular reporting on KPIs like first-pass claim rate, denial rate, Days in A/R, and net collection ratio.
